name: BrandProductRail
description: Responsive brand-led commerce rail composed from ProductList, compact ProductCard, and shared rail navigation controls.

figma.notes: PC behavior follows the YAMI homepage reference; mobile behavior follows the Figma brand-mobile / campaign composition.

title.description: Visible section heading and accessible label.

mobileTitle.description: Optional mobile-only section heading; falls back to title.

titleFontFamily.description: Optional serif treatment for editorial section headings.

campaigns.description: Ordered brand campaigns with a banner and ProductList items.

mobileSurface.description: Mobile section surface. Plain is full-bleed with 16px content padding and supports section dividers.

tabs.description: Optional mobile category tabs composed with the existing tertiary Tabs.

defaultValue.description: Initial uncontrolled mobile category tab value.

viewAllHref.description: Destination for the optional view-all link.

previousLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the previous-page button.

nextLabel.description: Localized accessible name for the next-page button.

onAddToCart.description: Reports the campaign and product IDs from the reused ProductCard quick-add action.

dividerPosition.description: Places the section boundary above, below, or removes it; card mobile ignores it while plain mobile preserves it.

dividerVariant.description: Gray preserves the existing 1px structural separator; black uses the theme-aware 2px emphasis separator.

tapTarget.note: Paging and quick-add actions compose existing YAMI Button controls.

focus.note: Campaign, product, view-all, and paging controls retain token-backed focus rings.

--color-white-1000.selector: brand banner title and compact ProductCard image surfaces

--space-600.property: desktop section padding and responsive panel gap calculation

accessibility.role: labelled section containing a horizontally scrollable list of brand campaigns
accessibility.ariaPattern: section with heading, list/listitem campaign panels, links, and previous/next buttons
accessibility.structure: The visible heading labels the section. Each campaign composes a labelled ProductList containing ProductCard articles.
accessibility.interaction: Native horizontal scrolling remains available; desktop paging buttons report disabled edge states.
